name: validate-booking-no-overlap
description: Fase 1 MVP: rechaza bookings si el profesional tiene otro activo (pending/accepted/in_progress). Importar desde Directus Studio > Flows > Import, luego ajustar operation Run Script.

options.code: const active = await services.itemsService('bookings').readByQuery({ filter: { professional: { _eq: $trigger.payload.professional }, status: { _in: ['pending','accepted','in_progress'] } }, limit: 1 }); if (active && active.length) { throw new Error('PROFESSIONAL_BUSY: el profesional ya tiene una reserva activa'); }
